sections.content: Operators are symbols that work on values: + adds, - subtracts, * multiplies, / divides, and = assigns. Comparison operators (==, !=, >, <) produce booleans.
Every language shares these basics, though details differ — for example, some use % for remainder and ** for power.
Key points: watch operator precedence (multiplication before addition), and = assigns while == compares in most languages.
